worldcombat.skill.appleacid.summary: Hurl a sour apple: on impact it bursts into acid, lowering the Sp. Def of the main target and everyone around the landing point; a target already fermenting takes a harsher second hit (-2). A bubbling sour mash stays where it lands, fermenting those who step in and biting them repeatedly; the core is left on the ground. Ferment form lingers and stacks more easily; burst form hits harder and splashes wider.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.use.0: Throw a second apple at the same target to stack Sp. Def to -2
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.use.1: Splash several foes gathered around the landing point
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.use.2: Seal off a patch of ground with the leftover sour mash
The apple deals %1$s special damage to the target it hits and lowers its Sp. Def by %2$s stage(s).
The apple flies %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, splashing %4$s onto everyone within %3$s blocks of the landing point.
Those it hits carry a ferment for %2$s; a second apple within that time instead lowers %1$s stage(s) of Sp. Def.
A %1$s-block sour mash stays %3$s, biting everyone inside for %2$s every %4$s; stepping in also ferments them.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.ferment.on: Ferment form: impact %1$s, ferment %2$s, mash %3$s — far easier to stack.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.ferment.off: Burst form: impact %1$s, splash radius %2$s, ferment %3$s — a harder, wider single throw.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.growth.0: From level %1$s the impact rises to %2$s power and the splash to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.preference.f: On: a slower apple with a lighter impact and splash and a smaller splash, but ferment ×1.6 and a longer mash — far easier to stack -2 on one target. Off (burst form): a harder, wider and faster single throw, but the acid does not linger.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in first. Larger values let it open from further away.
On: it prefers throwing another apple at a target that is already fermenting (the second hit is harsher, -2). Off: it sorts like an ordinary ranged attack.
